State-of-the-art physical infrastructure Reprint 2026-27 Chapter 7.indd 169 11/27/2025 12:39:11 PM Introduction Imagine you wake up one morning, ready for school.
The lights won’t turn on, the internet is gone, and the tap is running dry!
How would groceries, and stationery reach your nearest market and your home?
This is what life might look like without physical infrastructure, which is a vast network of tangible structures built to keep our cities and villages functioning.

It includes transportation systems (roads, bridges, railways, etc.), utilities (electricity, water pipelines), communication networks (internet, telephone lines, telecom towers, etc.), energy infrastructure (windmills, solar parks, oil and gas pipelines, etc.) and so on.
